title: Sraid Mabbot.
html_source:
(Irish) Mabbot Street. There should be an accent on the first a: Sráid Mabbot. Mabbot Street was renamed Corporation Street, which was recently renamed James Joyce Street.
Wikibooks: Annotations to James Joyce’s Ulysses
